description: Resolve the production dependency tree for a package version (up to a configurable depth). Shows the full transitive dependency graph with versions. Issues one registry request per discovered package (10 in flight), so a wide tree at depth 4-5 can take a while; the walk is capped at 60s and returns `truncated: true` with a warning if it runs out of budget.

depth.description: Max tree depth where the root counts as level 1 (default 3 = root + 2 transitive levels, max 5)

name: npm_dep_tree
